svg.title: Württemberg study map
svg.desc: Orientation map with representative study locations and selected rivers and towns. Country and state outlines are geographic context, not appellation boundaries. No vineyard parcels or elevation model are implied. 1: Württemberg; 2: Fellbach; 3: Untertürkheim; 4: Stuttgart; 5: Besigheim; 6: Weinsberg; 7: Schwaigern; 8: Bönnigheim; 9: Brackenheim; 10: Obereisesheim; 11: Fasanenhof; 12: Ulm

g.text: Light markers: study locations · dark markers: geographic context · teal: water

text.tspan: Follow the land. Compare the wines.
Open this map in the Codex for terroir, grapes, growing, cellar
choices and service. Dots locate places; they do not define a wine

g.text: Natural Earth · GeoNames CC BY 4.0 · representative locations · no appellation boundaries
